name: Maraxus
description: Volrath's masked warlord and mercenary, who draws strength from those around him, hunts Starke with sawtooth ogres and is killed by Starke.

timeline.summary: Maraxus corners Starke in his tent at night and threatens to kill him for betraying Volrath's secrets.
timeline.quote: "You spoke his secrets to an enemy," the figure growled.

timeline.summary: Starke offers Maraxus the woman who knows where Gerrard is, claiming she can draw Gerrard from hiding, and Maraxus orders him to bring her.
Starke lunges at Maraxus with his dagger but finds only darkness, as Maraxus has vanished.
timeline.quote: His blade only found darkness. The figure was gone.

timeline.summary: Sisay is abducted through the circle, and Starke leaves Volrath's abduction note beside her ring and flees the ship.
timeline.quote: Starke shivered as he put Volrath's abduction note on the table with Sisay's ring.

timeline.summary: Starke recalls how Maraxus forced him to help take Sisay prisoner, yet Volrath and Maraxus still refused to free him or his daughter.
timeline.quote: He had gained nothing by betraying Sisay

timeline.summary: Maraxus's forces drag Starke out of Alaric's wine cellar and tear down Alaric's mansion.
timeline.quote: Maraxus's forces tore down Alaric's elegant mansion in the canyons

timeline.summary: Maraxus tells Starke that Alaric is dead and that Volrath is not through with him, and orders him taken to camp.
timeline.quote: "Your friend who hides you is dead," Maraxus said simply.

timeline.summary: Starke whispers to Gerrard that Maraxus has a secret that might kill him.
Maraxus and his ogre platoon find the sleeping group at dawn and attack, demanding Starke.
timeline.quote: "Give me the traitor," Maraxus demanded of Gerrard

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight drops from above into the ogres, scattering them and killing most of them, leaving only Maraxus.
timeline.quote: And then the Weatherlight fell from above, dropping amidst the ogres, scattering them like leaves on the breeze.

timeline.summary: Gerrard sends Tahngarth, Crovax and Starke to the ship to leave him alone against Maraxus, whose strength depends on those around him.
timeline.quote: that you draw your strength from whatever's around you, whoever's near. Look around. You're alone.

timeline.summary: Gerrard duels Maraxus and wounds him, and Maraxus's strength drains away.
timeline.quote: Gerrard landed a clean cut across the warlord's sword arm.

timeline.summary: Starke, hiding behind a boulder, stabs Maraxus in the back of the neck, and Maraxus falls dead.
timeline.quote: searching blindly for the dagger buried at the base of his neck

timeline.summary: Starke admits he killed Maraxus to stop him exposing the betrayal of Sisay, and offers to lead Gerrard to Rath for his daughter's freedom.
timeline.quote: I can lead you to Rath,

relations.note: Starke suspects Volrath sent him; Maraxus works with Volrath.
relations.quote: He already knew that Volrath and Maraxus would not give him back his daughter
And then came Maraxus, Volrath's mercenary

relations.note: Stabs him in the neck with a dagger.
relations.quote: waiting for the moment to free himself from Maraxus by murdering him.

relations.note: He hunts Starke on Volrath's orders.
relations.quote: "Volrath is not through with you," he said.

pages_say.description: A monstrous warlord of Keld who threatens Starke in the dark and commands him to bring Sisay.
Volrath's masked warlord and mercenary, who draws strength from those around him, hunts Starke with sawtooth ogres and is killed by Starke.
